lhs: Unit-window reduction at each valid output point, evaluating the selected add/min/max with its actual initializer and translated input sample, or returning the seed when no sample exists.
rhs: When the signed whole-axis crop guard fires, broadcast the seed; otherwise pointwise-op the operand and seed, slice at the computed static endpoints, and pad with the seed.
conditions: Static nonempty single-input and single-output arrays, positive rank and positive output extents; no reversal, all sizes, stride and dilations one. Signed host integers assumed representable for source interpretation.
types: Exact integers. Any seed for the evaluator’s skip-outside calculation; documented identity-seed execution subdomain distinguished.
overlap: One parameterized case for three reducers, four optional-pad/crop combinations and early crop-all. Historical unit_gather proves affine reads and exact fixed-point reductions; existing signed Pad reverses the Slice/Pad order. Distinct work is proving actual interval validity, output shape, whole-axis exception and coordinates.
